body:
**_An average medieval build with elements of the industry that is suitable for a lover of dungeons and bosses, as well as for a lover of hellish torments with technology.Great for pair survival when your friend is a tech-loving nutcase._**

**What you will see:**
1. Modified generation
2. Modified old and added new dungeons
3. Epic bosses and soundtracks
4. Mythical creatures
5. Different types of weapons
